frontmatter.title: Automating Algorithm Discovery: A Case Study in Spot Instance Scheduling
frontmatter.author: Zhifei Li, Tian Xia, Shu Liu, Audrey Cheng, Melissa Pan, Ion Stoica, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: This post is the second in our ADRS series, where we apply AI to optimize complex system problems. Here, we tackle spot instance scheduling, a classic cost-versus-reliability problem in the cloud. We demonstrate how OpenEvolve discovers novel algorithms that surpass the algorithm from an NSDI'24 Best Paper, achieving up to 16% and 48% cost savings in single and multi-region setups, respectively.
